candidate.title: Incremental-link bounded DAG tabu with evolving elites v2
candidate.hypothesis: Move beyond time scaling. v1 rebuilds every machine arc for every neighbor and uses only dispatch-generated elites. v2 updates links only on the moved row, memoized DFS computes exact earliest starts with cycle detection and safe nonnegative tardiness partial-sum cutoffs, fixes aspiration ordering, randomizes machine traversal, and learns diverse local-search elites for restarts. Same weighted tardiness objective and tiny-flow tie break. Adaptation of generic critical-path tabu and elite diversification ideas, not a reproduction of published GRASP or shifting bottleneck. Equal-budget comparison to v1 at 300s on public inspected cases, then cross-seed confirmation.

candidate.title: Critical-path insertion tabu C++ v1
candidate.hypothesis: Replace short Python hint plus CP-SAT with standalone high-throughput disjunctive machine-order tabu search. Earliest-start DAG decoding evaluates total weighted tardiness exactly. Tight paths from tardy completions guide insertion neighborhoods; tabu relative-order attributes, weighted-completion tie breaking, perturbations and randomized ATC dispatch restarts escape local minima. Inspired by neighborhood research (Kuhpfahl and Bierwirth 2015, DOI 10.1016/j.cor.2015.07.011), not a reproduction. Test correctness and ability to close published gap with a longer single-worker search.

candidate.title: Independent CP-SAT machine/job/window destroy-and-repair LNS
candidate.hypothesis: Establish a stronger non-tabu comparator and explore exact multi-operation repair. Build input-derived randomized ATC schedules, improve with bounded Python critical-path insertion search, then CP-SAT repeatedly frees entire machines, selected jobs or time windows while retaining the relative order of other operations, with occasional full-model search. Unlike fixed-start neighborhoods, every operation may shift in time. Full intervals, release/precedence and weighted tardiness objective. This adapts generic destroy-and-repair and shifting-bottleneck ideas, not a reproduction of the published complete methods. Test matched300-second quality against frozen C++v2 on the inspected public cases. Independent implementation, no saved schedules or source/workspace access.
